explanation: Polysemantic layer-1 detector with three triggers. (1) A corporate suffix (' Inc', ' Ltd', ' LLC', weaker ' Corp') right after a multi-word company name, strongest when a comma comes first ('Acme Systems, Inc', 'Therapeutics Inc'), but near zero after a bare one-word name ('Apple Inc'). (2) The top-level domain 'com' (weaker 'org'/'net') after an email or web domain. (3) Clinical-study and case-report words: ' trial', ' consecutive', 'patients who', '-year-old', 'admitted to the hospital'. Ordinary prose stays silent.
